meta.phase-name: Canonical Content Accessors And Stat-Surface Normalization

outcomes.item: `contracts/index.ts` now exports canonical `LIST` / `BY_ID` / `BY_KEY` style accessors for the main stat, action, spell, rune, item, quest, and event collections.
`packages/engine/src/index.ts` re-exports those accessors so consumers import a single canonical package surface instead of rebuilding local lookup maps.
`game.ts` now consumes contract accessors for spell/rune/action metadata instead of maintaining local `Map` lookups.
The runtime-owned `GameEvent` surface now carries `narrativeStatDelta` instead of the older split event delta fields, and the supporting docs/tests/scripts were updated accordingly.
`GAME_STRUCTURE.md` now explicitly describes docs-site/Payload as the editorial platform, the canonical asset layers, the accessor/export conventions, and the current workflow.

follow-ups.item: Accessor generation is still manual in `contracts/index.ts`; if this surface keeps growing, it should move to real codegen instead of hand-maintained exports.
Historical deed/rumor memory still carries trait/feature split internals and is the next remaining normalization seam after 62-03 finishes.
